findings.excerpt: our top three customers, all of which are distributors, accounted for an aggregate of 54%, 61% and 55% of our revenue in the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively. Concentration in a small number of distributors increases our exposure to their credit profiles, inventory practices, covenant constraints, and strategic priorities
